reasons.customer: Five-questions test on the phone (sheet-mobile.png, mobile-fold.png): all six of the customer's questions are answered, in the order they ask them. (1) What is it, for me: the mobile fold shows 'WEDDING ORGANIZER · JAKARTA', the promise, a plain sub-line and the WhatsApp CTA, all inside 844px. (2) Cost and where the money goes: 'Koordinasi hari H mulai Rp 9,5 juta' plus 'Vendor kalian bayar langsung; pelunasan fee kami setelah acara' are already on the fold. The price section (mobile-page-02..05) shows three tiers, a 30/40/30 split with H+1 settlement, 'Biaya tambahan: tidak ada' and Kalian→vendor / Kalian→Jalinan, then names the fraud case ('Kenapa begini'). For this anxious audience this is the strongest part of the page. (3) Real: the 'Takut ketemu WO bodong? Wajar. Cek kami dulu.' checklist (mobile-page-05/06) gives office hours, NIB, vendor phone list, sample contract and the last three couples. These are things they can verify offline, which fits the wariness well. (4) When: the H-365..H+1 table (mobile-page-07) is short, scannable, ties payment stages to milestones and can be shared with parents. (5) Will the day run: the hour-by-hour section keeps the pinned clock strip on mobile (mobile-page-09) and includes a rain plan B at 13.30. (6) Cancel: answered twice, in the price block and in the FAQ. A sticky 'Cek tanggal via WhatsApp' bar is always within thumb reach. It falls short of 9 because the 'good' half of question 3 has no on-page evidence (digest: proof words none, logo images 0, no past weddings), and because the price-by-guest-count question stays ambiguous.

problems: Question 3 is half answered: the page shows you can CHECK they are real, but nothing shows they are GOOD. There are no past weddings, no couple's words and no count or years (digest: 'proof words: none'). A couple deciding with parents wants to see work before they visit an office. Smallest fix: in 'Cek kami', add a 3-item strip of recent weddings (initials, venue, guest count, month) with one short line from each couple, plus one number (e.g. 'X pernikahan sejak 20XX').

Price versus guest count contradicts itself. The package cards fix the crew size (Hari H '6 kru', Pendampingan '8 kru', Penuh '10 kru'), but the day section says 'Kru menyesuaikan tamu: 6 orang untuk sampai 300 tamu, 8 untuk 600, 10 untuk 1.000'. A couple with 600 guests cannot tell whether Rp 9,5 jt still applies. Smallest fix: on each card, replace 'N kru' with 'kru sesuai jumlah tamu' and add one line under the tiers stating whether the fee changes with guest count (and by how much).

On the phone the promise breaks badly: 'Hari H berjalan. / Kalian / tinggal hadir.' (mobile-fold.png). 'Kalian' sits orphaned on its own line and splits the second sentence of the headline. Smallest fix: put a non-breaking space in 'Kalian tinggal' or use text-wrap: balance on the H1 so it reads 'Hari H berjalan. / Kalian tinggal hadir.' Secondary: the Kalian→vendor / Kalian→Jalinan cards are cramped at 390px (mobile-page-04), so stack the label above the text.
keep: Price and the payment rule on the first screen ('mulai Rp 9,5 juta', vendor paid directly, settlement after the event)
30/40/30 with settlement at H+1 and the direct vendor-payment diagram, plus the plain 'Kenapa begini' fraud story
The 'Cek kami dulu' checklist of things they can verify offline (office, NIB, vendor phones, contract, past couples)
H-365..H+1 table with payment stages tagged, shareable to parents
Hour-by-hour day with the rain plan B; the pinned clock strip on mobile
Sticky WhatsApp CTA on mobile and the 'one wedding per day, max six per month' line
Cancellation answered in both the price block and the FAQ
